entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just connect me to someone. NOW.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this helmet I bought. Your return process online is a complete joke and I'm losing my patience.
I'm very sorry to hear you've had trouble with the website. I can definitely help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. I don't understand why this is so difficult. I have the helmet right here, the box is unopened. I just want my money back.

Thank you for that. I'm pulling it up now. I see the Urban Commuter Helmet. I can certainly look into the return options. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? The issue is that the color is completely wrong! It looked charcoal on your website but it's some kind of weird faded black. It's hideous. I'm not compromising on my safety with a product from a company that can't even get a color right.
I understand completely, and I apologize that the color wasn't what you expected. Let me just review the return eligibility for your order. I see it was delivered 38 days ago.

Thirty-eight days, so what? I told you, the box is unopened! Are you going to deny this? Because if you are, I want to speak to your manager right now. I will light up your social media with reviews about this disaster.
No, not at all, sir. I apologize for the confusion. I just need to confirm our policy. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that for this item, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the date of delivery.
So?
So you are well within the return window. I've gone ahead and approved your return. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You can just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Fine. About time. And I'll get a full refund, right? No restocking fee nonsense?
That's correct. A full refund to your original method of payment as soon as the helmet is received back at our warehouse.
Okay. Good. That's all I wanted.
Great. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
